BloodiedTriumphs.Title: Bloodied Triumphs
BloodiedTriumphs.Description: Critical moments achieved by a hero who is already badly hurt.

SurroundedStillStanding.Title: Surrounded, Still Standing
SurroundedStillStanding.Description: Critical moments achieved while several enemies immediately threaten the hero in melee.

GiantSlayerMoments.Title: Giant-Slayer Moments
GiantSlayerMoments.Description: Critical moments against opponents far beyond the hero in power and level.

NarrowEscapes.Title: Narrow Escapes
NarrowEscapes.Description: Critical moments achieved when several dangerous circumstances converge.

EnableBloodiedTriumphs.Name: Enable Bloodied Triumphs
EnableBloodiedTriumphs.Hint: Registers Bloodied Triumphs as an active Critical Forge theme pack.

EnableSurroundedStillStanding.Name: Enable Surrounded, Still Standing
EnableSurroundedStillStanding.Hint: Registers the theme pack for heroes immediately threatened by several enemies.

EnableGiantSlayerMoments.Name: Enable Giant-Slayer Moments
EnableGiantSlayerMoments.Hint: Registers the theme pack for critical success against substantially higher-level opponents.

EnableNarrowEscapes.Name: Enable Narrow Escapes
EnableNarrowEscapes.Hint: Registers the theme pack for critical moments under an especially dangerous combination of circumstances.

BloodiedThreshold.Name: Bloodied Triumphs threshold
BloodiedThreshold.Hint: Maximum current hit point ratio at which an actor counts as bloodied. Default: 0.5 or 50%.

SurroundedThreshold.Name: Required threatening enemies
SurroundedThreshold.Hint: Minimum number of automatically evaluated melee threats for Surrounded, Still Standing.

GiantSlayerThreshold.Name: Giant-Slayer level gap
GiantSlayerThreshold.Hint: Minimum difference between the opponent's level and the rolling actor's level.

NarrowEscapeThreshold.Name: Narrow Escape danger score
NarrowEscapeThreshold.Hint: Minimum score of the additive danger model. The current formula is documented by the module.

Notifications.Refreshed: Against All Odds packs were refreshed.
Notifications.RegistrationFailed: PF2E Critical Forge: Against All Odds could not register with Critical Forge. See the console for details.

NotYet.Title: Not Yet
NotYet.Description: Pain turns into force before it can become weakness. For 1 round, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Strike damage.

PainHonedEdge.Title: Pain-Honed Edge
PainHonedEdge.Description: Every wound redraws the line of your next attack. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.

BackAgainstTheWorld.Title: Against the Whole World
BackAgainstTheWorld.Description: Your counterstroke tears open the defense that should have ended you. The target is off-guard for 1 round.

BloodInTheStride.Title: Blood in the Grip
BloodInTheStride.Description: The pain steadies your hands and gives your threat a terrible certainty. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics and Intimidation checks.

YouFlinchFirst.Title: You Flinch First
YouFlinchFirst.Description: The target recoils before the wounded creature that should have broken. The target becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round.

CrimsonAfterimage.Title: Crimson Afterimage
CrimsonAfterimage.Description: The spell leaves a second, blood-red impact inside every wound it opens. For 1 round, you gain a +2 status bonus to spell damage.

WillThroughTheWound.Title: Will Through the Wound
WillThroughTheWound.Description: The successful spell proves that your will is still stronger than your injuries. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws.

WoundHoldsTheWeave.Title: The Wound Holds the Weave
WoundHoldsTheWeave.Description: For one impossible moment, your injuries anchor magic instead of weakening it. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to all damage.

ScarletOpening.Title: Scarlet Opening
ScarletOpening.Description: The critical spell leaves the target's defenses traced in red. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to saving throws.

OneMoreBreath.Title: One More Breath
OneMoreBreath.Description: The spell buys a heartbeat from a future that had already spent it. You may immediately Step as a free action, following the normal restrictions of Step.

BloodAnswersBlood.Title: Blood Answers Blood
BloodAnswersBlood.Description: Your own wounds make the strike cruelly exact. The target takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

BreachForEveryone.Title: A Breach for Everyone
BreachForEveryone.Description: Your critical blow opens a seam that every weapon can find. For 1 round, the target gains weakness 2 to weapons.

StealTheirBeat.Title: Steal Their Beat
StealTheirBeat.Description: The hit lands exactly when the enemy needs their rhythm most. The target becomes slowed 1 for 1 round.

StrengthRunsRed.Title: Strength Runs Red
StrengthRunsRed.Description: The wound steals leverage from every motion that follows. The target becomes enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

HuntTheOpening.Title: Hunt the Opening
HuntTheOpening.Description: The critical blow creates a path and your wounded body takes it before caution can object. You may immediately Step as a free action, but you must end the Step closer to the target if possible.

Spellscar.Title: Spellscar
Spellscar.Description: The magic does not merely strike; it leaves a place where more magic wants to enter. For 1 round, the target gains weakness 2 to damage from spells.

PainHoldsTheFormula.Title: Pain Holds the Formula
PainHoldsTheFormula.Description: Your injuries strip away every unnecessary thought until only the spell remains. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your spell DC.

ThoughtBleedsBack.Title: Thought Bleeds Back
ThoughtBleedsBack.Description: The mental impact rebounds through the opening it created. The target becomes stupefied 1 for 1 round.

PowerRefusesToFade.Title: Power Refuses to Fade
PowerRefusesToFade.Description: The spell should be over. The pain in your body refuses to let it end. The target takes 1d4 persistent force damage.

MagicNailsTheShadow.Title: Magic Nails the Shadow
MagicNailsTheShadow.Description: The spell pins the target's motion to the instant of impact. For 1 round, the target takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

DriveThemBack.Title: Drive Them Back
DriveThemBack.Description: The critical blow gives you one brutal instant of leverage. If the triggering attack was melee, you may immediately attempt to Shove the target as a free action; the Shove uses its normal rules and contributes to your multiple attack penalty. Apply this result manually.

RuinTheirAim.Title: Ruin Their Aim
RuinTheirAim.Description: Your shot does not need to kill to spoil the enemy's next line. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

BoneRingsLikeABell.Title: Bone Rings Like a Bell
BoneRingsLikeABell.Description: The bludgeoning impact travels through the target faster than balance can answer. The target falls prone.

CutToTheCore.Title: Cut to the Core
CutToTheCore.Description: The slashing wound makes every attempt to brace or resist visibly harder. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Fortitude DC.

FindTheNerve.Title: Find the Nerve
FindTheNerve.Description: The piercing strike finds a point the target cannot move without remembering. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC.

LightInTheWound.Title: Light in the Wound
LightInTheWound.Description: The spell leaves brightness burning where the target expected pain. After a critical light spell attack, the target is dazzled for 1 round.

ThunderInTheBlood.Title: Thunder in the Blood
ThunderInTheBlood.Description: The sonic impact leaves the world ringing behind it. After a critical sonic spell attack, the target is deafened for 1 round.

ColdStealsTheStep.Title: Cold Steals the Step
ColdStealsTheStep.Description: Frost locks around the target's stride before the pain can fade. For 1 round after a critical cold spell attack, the target takes a 10-foot circumstance penalty to its land Speed.

LightningStealsAHeartbeat.Title: Lightning Steals a Heartbeat
LightningStealsAHeartbeat.Description: The current arrives in the target's nerves before its thoughts can follow. After a critical electricity spell attack, the target becomes stunned 1.

AcidFindsTheSeam.Title: Acid Finds the Seam
AcidFindsTheSeam.Description: The acid does not need to eat through everything; it only needs to show where the protection ends. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC.

HeartRefuses.Title: The Heart Refuses
HeartRefuses.Description: The body hears the order to fail and answers with another beat. For 1 round, you gain 6 temporary Hit Points.

BitterBlood.Title: Bitter Blood
BitterBlood.Description: Your wounded body turns hostile to every toxin that enters it. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to poison damage.

BodyAsBastion.Title: Body as Bastion
BodyAsBastion.Description: Muscle, bone, and stubbornness lock into one defensive shape. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and Fortitude DC.

FleshBecomesArmor.Title: Flesh Becomes Armor
FleshBecomesArmor.Description: Pain hardens the body faster than steel can break it. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to physical damage.

SecondPulse.Title: Second Pulse
SecondPulse.Description: A second rhythm rises beneath the first and drags you back from the brink. For 1 round, you gain fast healing 4.

NoRoomForNausea.Title: No Room for Nausea
NoRoomForNausea.Description: Your body has more urgent work than surrendering to sickness. For 1 round, you are immune to the sickened condition.

BloodObeys.Title: Blood Obeys
BloodObeys.Description: The blood already spilled is enough; the rest stays where you command it. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to bleed damage.

NervesRefuse.Title: The Nerves Refuse
NervesRefuse.Description: Shock races through you and finds every nerve already occupied by defiance. For 1 round, you are immune to the stunned condition.

StrengthDoesNotLeave.Title: Strength Does Not Leave
StrengthDoesNotLeave.Description: Your strength may bend, but for one more moment it cannot be taken from you. For 1 round, you are immune to the enfeebled condition.

CloseTheWound.Title: Close the Wound
CloseTheWound.Description: Your body seizes one injury and forces it toward an ending. You may immediately attempt the recovery check for one persistent damage effect affecting you, using DC 10 instead of its normal DC.

DeathHasNoPurchase.Title: Death Has No Purchase
DeathHasNoPurchase.Description: Death reaches for a body that has already decided to remain. For 1 round, you are immune to death effects.

IronLungs.Title: Iron Lungs
IronLungs.Description: You seize one clean breath and refuse to surrender it. For 1 round, you are immune to inhaled effects.

NoBloodForTheVoid.Title: No Blood for the Void
NoBloodForTheVoid.Description: The emptiness claws at what little remains and finds your life clenched tight. For 1 round, you gain resistance 4 to void damage.

ScarsGuardTheHeart.Title: Scars Guard the Heart
ScarsGuardTheHeart.Description: Old wounds teach the new one where not to land. For 1 round, you gain resistance 4 to precision damage.

PainLeavesRoomForHealing.Title: Pain Leaves Room for Healing
PainLeavesRoomForHealing.Description: Every torn edge of you reaches toward repair. For 1 round, you gain a +2 status bonus to healing you receive.

FleshRemembers.Title: Flesh Remembers
FleshRemembers.Description: For one impossible heartbeat, your body remembers a shape without wounds. For 1 round, you gain regeneration 3, deactivated by acid or fire damage; while the regeneration is active, your dying value cannot increase above 3.

CoreAgainstTheElements.Title: Core Against the Elements
CoreAgainstTheElements.Description: Heat, frost, lightning, and worse meet a body too stubborn to yield. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to energy damage.

PressureMeetsStone.Title: Pressure Meets Stone
PressureMeetsStone.Description: Anything trying to drag, crush, or force you aside finds stone where flesh should be. For 1 round, your Fortitude DC gains a +2 circumstance bonus.

LastReserve.Title: The Last Reserve
LastReserve.Description: Your body opens one last reserve and spreads it across every wound at once. For 1 round, you gain resistance 1 to all damage.

BodyCastsItOut.Title: The Body Casts It Out
BodyCastsItOut.Description: Your body names one burden foreign and expels it by force. Immediately reduce your sickened, drained, or enfeebled condition by 1 (choose one); apply this result manually.

LastQuarter.Title: The Last Quarter
LastQuarter.Description: When almost nothing remains, the body stops spending strength on anything but survival. While at one-quarter Hit Points or less, this critical save grants you a +1 status bonus to saving throws for 1 round.

WoundedStandsTaller.Title: Wounded Stands Taller
WoundedStandsTaller.Description: The wound is no longer only damage; it is leverage. If you are wounded, you gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics and Fortitude saves for 1 round.

RingOfEnemiesBecomesArmor.Title: The Ring of Enemies Becomes Armor
RingOfEnemiesBecomesArmor.Description: When enemies close from every side, your body stops giving any one of them a clean line. If at least two enemies threaten you, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC for 1 round.

EveryBreathIsChosen.Title: Every Breath Is Chosen
EveryBreathIsChosen.Description: You stop wasting motion on pain. For 1 round, your land Speed gains a +5-foot status bonus.

HandsStillObey.Title: The Hands Still Obey
HandsStillObey.Description: The body may be failing in pieces, but the hands still know exactly what comes next. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

BodySetsItsWeight.Title: The Body Sets Its Weight
BodySetsItsWeight.Description: Your stance becomes an argument made of bone. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks and Fortitude DC.

PainNarrowsTheWorld.Title: Pain Narrows the World
PainNarrowsTheWorld.Description: Everything irrelevant falls away until danger is the only clear shape left. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks.

HoldTheLineInside.Title: Hold the Line Inside
HoldTheLineInside.Description: The body wins one argument with itself and the mind borrows the momentum. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves.

WoundCannotSurpriseYou.Title: The Wound Cannot Surprise You
WoundCannotSurpriseYou.Description: You have already felt the worst version of the next impact in your imagination. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to damage from critical hits.

StandBecauseYouMust.Title: Stand Because You Must
StandBecauseYouMust.Description: If you are prone, you may immediately Stand as a free action. This Stand does not trigger reactions; apply this result manually.

BetweenTheBlades.Title: Between the Blades
BetweenTheBlades.Description: There is no safe path, so you make one between the edges. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves and Reflex DC.

BloodRedBlur.Title: Blood-Red Blur
BloodRedBlur.Description: For one heartbeat, your wounded outline becomes impossible to follow. For 1 round, you are concealed.

RunBeforeFalling.Title: Run Before Falling
RunBeforeFalling.Description: Your body spends tomorrow's strength on surviving now. For 1 round, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your land Speed.

TurnTheBlastAside.Title: Turn the Blast Aside
TurnTheBlastAside.Description: You do not escape the force completely; you teach it to pass around what remains of you. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to area damage.

NoAngleLeft.Title: No Angle Left
NoAngleLeft.Description: Every line of attack closes a fraction too late. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

NeverWhereNeeded.Title: Never Where They Expect You
NeverWhereNeeded.Description: The enemy's perfect opening keeps finding empty air. For 1 round, you are immune to the off-guard condition.

FeetRefuseGround.Title: The Feet Refuse the Ground
FeetRefuseGround.Description: Even the floor cannot decide where to catch you. For 1 round, you are immune to the prone condition.

WoundTaughtBalance.Title: Wound-Taught Balance
WoundTaughtBalance.Description: Pain has become a map of every dangerous shift in your weight. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

SlipTheSnare.Title: Slip the Snare
SlipTheSnare.Description: Nothing gets to hold you while survival still has somewhere else to be. For 1 round, you are immune to the immobilized condition.

TwoHeartbeatsAhead.Title: Two Heartbeats Ahead
TwoHeartbeatsAhead.Description: You are already leaving the place where death expected to find you. You may immediately Step twice as a free action. Each Step must move you farther from the hostile source, and the normal restrictions of Step apply.

MotionRefusesToDie.Title: Motion Refuses to Die
MotionRefusesToDie.Description: Pain strips away hesitation until every direction becomes escape. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all your Speeds.

WoundReadsTheAngle.Title: The Wound Reads the Angle
WoundReadsTheAngle.Description: Every near miss teaches your body exactly where force wants to put you. For 1 round, your Reflex DC gains a +2 circumstance bonus.

NoGripHoldsTheWind.Title: No Grip Holds the Wind
NoGripHoldsTheWind.Description: Anything that closes around you discovers it has caught motion rather than flesh. For 1 round, you are immune to the grabbed and restrained conditions.

HitArrivesTooLate.Title: The Hit Arrives Too Late
HitArrivesTooLate.Description: Your body remembers the fraction of a second that separates a wound from a killing blow. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to damage from critical hits.

BloodKnowsTheExit.Title: Blood Knows the Exit
BloodKnowsTheExit.Description: You stop looking for safety and start moving toward it. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

DodgeBecomesCounterstroke.Title: Dodge Becomes Counterstroke
DodgeBecomesCounterstroke.Description: The motion that saves your life is already winding the next attack. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.

ReflexWithoutThought.Title: Reflex Without Thought
ReflexWithoutThought.Description: Conscious thought becomes too slow for survival. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to checks based on Dexterity.

MotionCannotBeStolen.Title: Motion Cannot Be Stolen
MotionCannotBeStolen.Description: You have too little life left to surrender even a heartbeat of movement. For 1 round, you are immune to the slowed condition.

NothingClings.Title: Nothing Clings
NothingClings.Description: Flame, acid, blood, and venom find no stable place on a body that will not stop moving. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to persistent damage.

ThroughTheImpossibleOpening.Title: Through the Impossible Opening
ThroughTheImpossibleOpening.Description: For one impossible instant, every threat points toward the same escape route. You may immediately Stride as a free action, moving no more than half your Speed. This movement does not trigger reactions; apply this result manually.

TheirLinesCrossBehindYou.Title: Their Lines Cross Behind You
TheirLinesCrossBehindYou.Description: When at least two enemies threaten you, your escape makes their angles interfere with one another. The hostile source becomes off-guard for 1 round.

FourBladesOneRhythm.Title: Four Blades, One Rhythm
FourBladesOneRhythm.Description: With four or more enemies threatening you, the chaos becomes a single readable pattern. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

QuarterBreathDefense.Title: Defense on a Quarter Breath
QuarterBreathDefense.Description: At one-quarter Hit Points or less, survival compresses into pure geometry. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex DC.

OverreachBecomesOpening.Title: Overreach Becomes Opening
OverreachBecomesOpening.Description: The hostile source commits too much to the attack you escaped. For 1 round, it takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

FireShowsTheGap.Title: Fire Shows the Gap
FireShowsTheGap.Description: The flame outlines the safe space you found inside it. After critically succeeding against fire damage, you gain resistance 4 to fire for 1 round.

AcidSlidesAway.Title: Acid Slides Away
AcidSlidesAway.Description: The same motion that saved you keeps the corrosive edge from settling. After critically succeeding against acid damage, you gain resistance 4 to acid for 1 round.

ColdCannotSettle.Title: Cold Cannot Settle
ColdCannotSettle.Description: You never give the frost enough stillness to take hold. After critically succeeding against cold damage, your land Speed gains a +5-foot status bonus for 1 round.

LightningTeachesTheLine.Title: Lightning Teaches the Line
LightningTeachesTheLine.Description: The current shows you the shortest path through danger. After critically succeeding against electricity damage, you gain a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves for 1 round.

SourceLosesSightOfYou.Title: The Source Loses Sight of You
SourceLosesSightOfYou.Description: Your evasive line leaves the hostile source looking where you were. For 1 round, it takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC.

BehindThemBeforeTheyTurn.Title: Behind Them Before They Turn
BehindThemBeforeTheyTurn.Description: You may immediately Step as a free action. If a legal path exists, you may end this Step on the opposite side of the hostile source from where you began. This movement does not trigger reactions; apply this result manually.

MindRefuses.Title: The Mind Refuses
MindRefuses.Description: Your thoughts close ranks around the one command that still matters: endure. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves and Will DC.

NothingLeftToFear.Title: Nothing Left to Fear
NothingLeftToFear.Description: Fear searches your wounds for purchase and finds every place already occupied by resolve. For 1 round, you are immune to the frightened condition.

NoMasterHere.Title: No Master Here
NoMasterHere.Description: The invading will reaches for a throne and finds only shattered stone and a blade waiting beneath it. For 1 round, you are immune to the controlled condition.

PainIsProof.Title: Pain Is Proof
PainIsProof.Description: The wound is real, the blood is real, and the lie has nowhere left to hide. For 1 round, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks and Will saves.

HeartRemembers.Title: The Heart Remembers
HeartRemembers.Description: Someone else may command your feelings, but they cannot rewrite why you are still standing. The hostile source becomes stupefied 1 for 1 round.

ThoughtBehindTheBlood.Title: Thought Behind the Blood
ThoughtBehindTheBlood.Description: Behind the pain, one untouched thought remains and shelters everything that follows. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to mental damage.

ClearAsTheWound.Title: Clear as the Wound
ClearAsTheWound.Description: Agony burns every false direction away until only the next necessary choice remains. For 1 round, you are immune to the confused condition.

EyesBehindTheEyes.Title: Eyes Behind the Eyes
EyesBehindTheEyes.Description: The assault opens a colder awareness behind your ordinary senses. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks and Perception DC.

DefianceLooksBack.Title: Defiance Looks Back
DefianceLooksBack.Description: The intruder meets your gaze from inside your own mind and realizes it has entered the wrong place. The hostile source becomes frightened 1 for 1 round.

CutTheHook.Title: Cut the Hook
CutTheHook.Description: The failed intrusion leaves its barb exposed. You may immediately reduce your frightened or stupefied condition by 1. Choose one condition if both apply.

WillShowsTeeth.Title: The Will Shows Teeth
WillShowsTeeth.Description: The hostile thought recoils and leaves its owner a fraction too slow to press the attack. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

NameRemains.Title: A Name Remains
NameRemains.Description: Pain strips away every borrowed voice until only your own remains. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to checks based on Wisdom and Charisma.

FearForgetsTheWay.Title: Fear Forgets the Way
FearForgetsTheWay.Description: Fear can still scream, but it can no longer tell your feet where to go. For 1 round, you are immune to the fleeing condition.

ForeignThoughtGivesItselfAway.Title: The Foreign Thought Gives Itself Away
ForeignThoughtGivesItselfAway.Description: Once the intrusion fails, you can see the intention behind it. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC.

ThoughtStrikesBack.Title: Thought Strikes Back
ThoughtStrikesBack.Description: The mental blow rebounds through the open channel. The hostile source takes 1d4 persistent mental damage.

IntruderLosesTheThread.Title: The Intruder Loses the Thread
IntruderLosesTheThread.Description: The failed assault leaves the enemy's next command tangled in its own intent. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Spell DC and Class DC.

PainBecomesAuthority.Title: Pain Becomes Authority
PainBecomesAuthority.Description: You have already paid the price of doubt. For 1 round, your Spell DC and Class DC gain a +1 status bonus.

NoSecondVoice.Title: No Second Voice
NoSecondVoice.Description: There is no room left in your skull for another voice to dull your thoughts. For 1 round, you are immune to the stupefied condition.

ClarityAfterTheStorm.Title: Clarity After the Storm
ClarityAfterTheStorm.Description: The failed intrusion leaves the rest of the world unnaturally simple. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to skill checks.

SlamTheDoorShut.Title: Slam the Door Shut
SlamTheDoorShut.Description: You seize the instant of clarity and lock one intruder outside yourself. Choose one ongoing effect with the mental trait currently affecting you. Its effects are suppressed until the end of your next turn, though its duration continues; apply this result manually.

MindLeavesAScar.Title: The Mind Leaves a Scar
MindLeavesAScar.Description: The failed intrusion leaves a path back to its owner. After a mental effect, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Will DC for 1 round.

FearBecomesACompass.Title: Fear Becomes a Compass
FearBecomesACompass.Description: Fear points at what matters and you choose to move toward it. After a fear effect, you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls for 1 round.

IllusionBreaksOnTheWound.Title: Illusion Breaks on the Wound
IllusionBreaksOnTheWound.Description: Pain gives the false world a hard edge it cannot imitate. After an illusion effect, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC for 1 round.

HeartChoosesItsRhythm.Title: The Heart Chooses Its Rhythm
HeartChoosesItsRhythm.Description: Someone tried to tell you what to feel; the refusal becomes conviction. After an emotion effect, you gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks for 1 round.

YourVoiceComesBackWrong.Title: Your Voice Comes Back Wrong
YourVoiceComesBackWrong.Description: The hostile sound rebounds through the space it tried to occupy. After an auditory effect, the hostile source is deafened for 1 round.

WordsLoseTheirTeeth.Title: Words Lose Their Teeth
WordsLoseTheirTeeth.Description: The sentence still reaches you, but its authority does not. After a linguistic effect, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves for 1 round.

CurseFindsAWitness.Title: The Curse Finds a Witness
CurseFindsAWitness.Description: You see the curse clearly enough to refuse its next lie. After a curse effect, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws for 1 round.

TooHurtToBeSmall.Title: Too Hurt to Be Small
TooHurtToBeSmall.Description: At one-quarter Hit Points or less, pain burns embarrassment and hesitation out of you. You gain a +1 status bonus to Intimidation and Will saves for 1 round.

ImpossibleIsNotEnough.Title: Impossible Is Not Enough
ImpossibleIsNotEnough.Description: The effect was meant to end the argument entirely. Instead, you answer it. After an incapacitation effect, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws for 1 round.

SeeTheHandBehindIt.Title: See the Hand Behind It
SeeTheHandBehindIt.Description: The failed assault reveals something about the creature behind it. You may immediately attempt an appropriate Recall Knowledge check about the hostile source as a free action, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to that check; apply this result manually.

CenterDoesNotBreak.Title: The Center Does Not Break
CenterDoesNotBreak.Description: Where others would retreat, you become the fixed point in the ring. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

BreakTheirRhythm.Title: Break Their Rhythm
BreakTheirRhythm.Description: Your counterstroke makes one fighter in the ring hesitate. For 1 round, a threatening target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and Athletics checks.

OneFoeBecomesTheGap.Title: One Foe Becomes the Gap
OneFoeBecomesTheGap.Description: Your critical hit turns a threatening enemy into the weak seam of the ring. For 1 round, the target becomes clumsy 1 and takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

ThreeBladesOneFocus.Title: Three Blades, One Focus
ThreeBladesOneFocus.Description: With three or more enemies pressing in, every threat becomes a landmark. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and Perception checks.

ThroughTheGap.Title: Through the Gap
ThroughTheGap.Description: The critical blow opens a heartbeat of space. You may immediately Step as a free action; if possible, end the Step in a space where fewer enemies threaten you. Apply this result manually.

PressureSharpensTheFormula.Title: Pressure Sharpens the Formula
PressureSharpensTheFormula.Description: Every closing blade strips another distraction from the spell. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to spell attack rolls.

MagicTearsTheFormation.Title: Magic Tears the Formation
MagicTearsTheFormation.Description: The spell makes a threatening enemy the weak seam of the formation. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to saving throws and Perception checks.

FourAgainstOne.Title: Four Against One
FourAgainstOne.Description: Four or more enemies close in and still the spell lands perfectly. The target becomes frightened 1.

RingTurnsInward.Title: The Ring Turns Inward
RingTurnsInward.Description: The spell makes one enemy the fault line in the whole formation. For 1 round, the target gains weakness 1 to all damage.

NoFreeAngle.Title: No Free Angle
NoFreeAngle.Description: The spell catches a threatening enemy where the formation gives it nowhere clean to move or strike. For 1 round, the target takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds and a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

TurnTheRingAgainstThem.Title: Turn the Ring Against Them
TurnTheRingAgainstThem.Description: You drive a threatening foe into the bad geometry of its own formation. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC and Athletics checks.

CrowdTheirFootwork.Title: Crowd Their Footwork
CrowdTheirFootwork.Description: Your hit makes a threatening enemy trip over the very pressure meant to trap you. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC and a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

MoreBladesFewerOpenings.Title: More Blades, Fewer Openings
MoreBladesFewerOpenings.Description: With three or more enemies crowding you, their attacks begin to obstruct one another. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex DC.

FourBodiesOneBottleneck.Title: Four Bodies, One Bottleneck
FourBodiesOneBottleneck.Description: With four or more enemies packed around you, a critical hit turns one threatening foe into a blockage. For 1 round, the target gains weakness 1 to weapons and takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

ShoulderTheRingOpen.Title: Shoulder the Ring Open
ShoulderTheRingOpen.Description: Your critical hit gives you one brutal instant to disrupt the encirclement. You may immediately attempt to Shove one currently threatening enemy other than the target as a free action. Apply this result manually.

SpellBetweenTheirBlades.Title: Spell Between Their Blades
SpellBetweenTheirBlades.Description: You cast through a forest of weapons without giving the ring a clean opening. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to spell attack rolls and AC.

ArcThroughTheCrowd.Title: Arc Through the Crowd
ArcThroughTheCrowd.Description: The spell uses the ring's own congestion against a threatening foe. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC and saving throws.

PressureFindsTheWeakLink.Title: Pressure Finds the Weak Link
PressureFindsTheWeakLink.Description: With three or more enemies closing in, your spell exposes the one whose concentration holds the line together. A threatening target becomes stupefied 1 and takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds for 1 round.

FourShadowsOneFlash.Title: Four Shadows, One Flash
FourShadowsOneFlash.Description: Four or more enemies crowd your sightlines, and the spell still finds the exact break in the ring. A threatening target becomes off-guard and frightened 1 for 1 round.

CarveAMagicalCorridor.Title: Carve a Magical Corridor
CarveAMagicalCorridor.Description: The spell punches a momentary lane through the encirclement. You may immediately Stride up to half your Speed as a free action; the spell's target cannot use reactions triggered by this movement. Apply this result manually.

MakeThemWatchEachOther.Title: Make Them Watch Each Other
MakeThemWatchEachOther.Description: Your critical hit forces a threatening foe to keep one eye on its own allies. For 1 round, the target is dazzled and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

HookTheOuterEdge.Title: Hook the Outer Edge
HookTheOuterEdge.Description: The hit gives you a heartbeat to orbit the ring instead of retreating from it. You may immediately Step twice as free actions; both Steps must keep you adjacent to at least one threatening enemy, and the target cannot react to this movement. Apply this result manually.

ThreeBladesHideTheTell.Title: Three Blades Hide the Tell
ThreeBladesHideTheTell.Description: With three or more enemies crowding your movements, their own weapons hide your next intention. For 1 round, you are concealed and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks.

FourBodiesOneDomino.Title: Four Bodies, One Domino
FourBodiesOneDomino.Description: With four or more enemies packed around you, the struck foe becomes the first piece in a chain reaction. You may immediately attempt to Shove the target as a free action; if it is moved into another threatening enemy's space or reach, the GM may shift that second enemy 5 feet to make room. Apply this result manually.

BreakTheirApproach.Title: Break Their Approach
BreakTheirApproach.Description: You strike the instant a threatening foe tries to settle into the ring. For 1 round, the target takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds and a -1 circumstance penalty to AC.

MagicMakesABlindSide.Title: Magic Makes a Blind Side
MagicMakesABlindSide.Description: Your spell turns the crowd itself into visual noise for a threatening foe. For 1 round, the target is dazzled and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC.

CrowdFeedsTheArc.Title: The Crowd Feeds the Arc
CrowdFeedsTheArc.Description: The ring gives your magic a line to run along. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds and a +1 circumstance bonus to spell damage.

ThreeThreatsOneAfterimage.Title: Three Threats, One Afterimage
ThreeThreatsOneAfterimage.Description: With three or more enemies tracking you at once, your spell leaves too many false lines to follow. For 1 round, you are concealed and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to spell attack rolls.

FourThreatsOneFaultline.Title: Four Threats, One Faultline
FourThreatsOneFaultline.Description: With four or more enemies pressing into the same formation, your spell breaks the threatening target at the seam between body and focus. For 1 round, it becomes clumsy 1 and stupefied 1.

BlinkThroughTheLine.Title: Blink Through the Line
BlinkThroughTheLine.Description: The critical spell leaves a momentary seam in the encirclement. You may immediately move up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see; this movement does not trigger reactions from enemies that currently threaten you. Apply this result manually.

BodyIsTheAnchor.Title: The Body Is the Anchor
BodyIsTheAnchor.Description: The ring presses inward and your stance ties defense to endurance. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Fortitude DC.

PressureHardensTheFrame.Title: Pressure Hardens the Frame
PressureHardensTheFrame.Description: Every enemy leaning into the crush teaches your body where to harden and brace. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to physical damage and a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks.

NoHandFindsPurchase.Title: No Hand Finds Purchase
NoHandFindsPurchase.Description: Too many hands reach for you, giving you leverage against every hold. For 1 round, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks and Fortitude DC.

ThreeAgainstStone.Title: Three Against Stone
ThreeAgainstStone.Description: With three or more enemies bearing down on you, every angle of pressure locks the next one in place. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

FourCannotFoldYou.Title: Four Cannot Fold You
FourCannotFoldYou.Description: Four or more threats close in and your whole body becomes one refusal. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws.

MakeThemSpendThemselves.Title: Make Them Spend Themselves
MakeThemSpendThemselves.Description: A threatening enemy commits too much force trying to break you. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and Athletics checks.

BreathBetweenBlows.Title: Breath Between Blows
BreathBetweenBlows.Description: You find one clean breath in a space where there should be none. For 1 round, you gain fast healing 3.

EveryWoundSharesTheLoad.Title: Every Wound Shares the Load
EveryWoundSharesTheLoad.Description: No single injury gets to own your attention while the ring is closing. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to persistent damage and fast healing 2.

CrowdGivesYouLeverage.Title: The Crowd Gives You Leverage
CrowdGivesYouLeverage.Description: Every body pressing inward becomes something to brace against. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks and attack rolls.

SetYourFeet.Title: Set Your Feet
SetYourFeet.Description: You root yourself against the whole ring at once. Until the start of your next turn, reduce any forced movement caused by a hostile effect by 10 feet, to a minimum of 0 feet. Apply this result manually.

TurnTheirWeightAgainstThem.Title: Turn Their Weight Against Them
TurnTheirWeightAgainstThem.Description: A threatening foe leans into the crush and gives you the leverage to break their stance. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks and Fortitude DC.

BraceOnTheirAdvance.Title: Brace on Their Advance
BraceOnTheirAdvance.Description: A foe's pressure becomes a brace instead of a burden. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Constitution-based checks.

ThreeBodiesOneBastion.Title: Three Bodies, One Bastion
ThreeBodiesOneBastion.Description: With three or more threats closing in, the pressure locks your frame into a single defensive structure. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves and Fortitude DC.

FourHandsOneMistake.Title: Four Hands, One Mistake
FourHandsOneMistake.Description: With four or more threats around you, one attacker overcommits and the whole ring stutters. A threatening hostile source becomes slowed 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Fortitude DC for 1 round.

BreakTheClinch.Title: Break the Clinch
BreakTheClinch.Description: The crush gives you one violent instant to wrench free. If you are grabbed, restrained, or immobilized, you may immediately attempt to Escape as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus. Otherwise, you may Step. Apply this result manually.

BreatheThroughTheCrush.Title: Breathe Through the Crush
BreatheThroughTheCrush.Description: You force one measured breath through the chaos and your body remembers its discipline. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves and Constitution-based checks.

UseTheRingAsLeverage.Title: Use the Ring as Leverage
UseTheRingAsLeverage.Description: Every body pressing inward becomes leverage for the next blow. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks and Strike damage.

OneBodyTakesTheWeight.Title: One Body Takes the Weight
OneBodyTakesTheWeight.Description: You shift the pressure onto one threatening foe and leave them fighting the rest of the ring. For 1 round, the hostile source is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks.

ForceMeetsFormation.Title: Force Meets Formation
ForceMeetsFormation.Description: A threatening foe drives into you and discovers the ring has nowhere left to give. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds and a -1 circumstance penalty to Fortitude DC.

MakeAShieldOfThem.Title: Make a Shield of Them
MakeAShieldOfThem.Description: Turn one threatening enemy into an obstacle for the rest. Choose a currently threatening foe; until the start of your next turn, treat that creature as cover against attacks from other threatening enemies whenever it physically blocks the line of attack. Apply this result manually.

OvercommitmentCostsThem.Title: Overcommitment Costs Them
OvercommitmentCostsThem.Description: A threatening enemy leans too much of its strength into the ring and pays for it. For 1 round, the hostile source becomes enfeebled 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

ShoulderThroughTheCrush.Title: Shoulder Through the Crush
ShoulderThroughTheCrush.Description: The press of bodies becomes something you can drive against. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds and a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC.

ThreeBodiesOneBearing.Title: Three Bodies, One Bearing
ThreeBodiesOneBearing.Description: With three or more enemies pushing inward, you find a single line through all their weight. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Athletics checks.

FourBodiesBreakTheirOwnLine.Title: Four Bodies Break Their Own Line
FourBodiesBreakTheirOwnLine.Description: With four or more enemies packed around you, the hostile source cannot recover its balance after the failed pressure. For 1 round, it becomes slowed 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

AnchorAndTurn.Title: Anchor and Turn
AnchorAndTurn.Description: You absorb the pressure, pivot on it, and make space where none existed. You may immediately Step as a free action; until the start of your next turn, reduce the first instance of forced movement that would move you by 5 feet. Apply this result manually.

TheirGripGoesSoft.Title: Their Grip Goes Soft
TheirGripGoesSoft.Description: A threatening source spends too much strength trying to hold you inside the ring. For 1 round, it becomes clumsy 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks.

WeightBecomesImpact.Title: Weight Becomes Impact
WeightBecomesImpact.Description: The ring gives every committed motion something solid to rebound from. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to strike damage and Fortitude DC.

BodyFindsTheSeam.Title: The Body Finds the Seam
BodyFindsTheSeam.Description: You feel the ring's pressure change before the opening is visible. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your land Speed and a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception DC.

BreakThePressureChain.Title: Break the Pressure Chain
BreakThePressureChain.Description: Choose two enemies that currently threaten you. Until the start of your next turn, treat those two enemies as unable to cooperate with one another for flanking or similar positional assistance against you. Apply this result manually.

StandThroughTheCrush.Title: Stand Through the Crush
StandThroughTheCrush.Description: The failed pressure leaves you one instant to reclaim your footing. If you are prone, grabbed, or restrained, you may immediately Stand or attempt to Escape as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus. Apply this result manually.

ThreadBetweenBlades.Title: Thread Between the Blades
ThreadBetweenBlades.Description: The ring leaves no path, so you turn the bodies inside it into landmarks. For 1 round, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks.

BodiesBecomeCover.Title: Bodies Become Cover
BodiesBecomeCover.Description: For one heartbeat, the enemies around you block one another's sightlines and attacks. You are concealed for 1 round and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex DC.

ThreeThreatsOneCurrent.Title: Three Threats, One Current
ThreeThreatsOneCurrent.Description: With three or more enemies threatening you, their motions merge into a single readable flow. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves.

FourThreatsOpenGround.Title: Four Threats, Open Ground
FourThreatsOpenGround.Description: With four or more enemies closing in, the only open ground is the ground you create. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all your Speeds.

OverreachOpensTheSource.Title: Overreach Opens the Source
OverreachOpensTheSource.Description: A threatening source commits too far into the crowded attack. For 1 round, it becomes off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

BalanceTurnsAgainstThem.Title: Balance Turns Against Them
BalanceTurnsAgainstThem.Description: Your escape forces the hostile source to recover its footing instead of pressing the advantage. For 1 round, its Reflex DC takes a -1 circumstance penalty.

NoOneOwnsYourBack.Title: No One Owns Your Back
NoOneOwnsYourBack.Description: The ring cannot agree which side of you is vulnerable. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, Perception checks, and Perception DC.

TooManyBodiesNoCleanShot.Title: Too Many Bodies, No Clean Shot
TooManyBodiesNoCleanShot.Description: Every enemy in the ring spoils another's perfect angle. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to precision damage.

EyesOnEveryOpening.Title: Eyes on Every Opening
EyesOnEveryOpening.Description: Tracking several threats at once sharpens your sense for the gap between them. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks and Perception DC.

GhostThroughTheRing.Title: Ghost Through the Ring
GhostThroughTheRing.Description: You may immediately Stride as a free action, moving no more than half your Speed. This movement does not trigger reactions from creatures that currently threaten you; if possible, end where fewer enemies threaten you. Apply this result manually.

EdgeBecomesExit.Title: The Edge Becomes an Exit
EdgeBecomesExit.Description: You stop treating the ring as a wall and start reading its edge as a route. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Acrobatics checks.

RingTripsOverItself.Title: The Ring Trips Over Itself
RingTripsOverItself.Description: A threatening source has to correct for the bodies crowding its attack. For 1 round, it takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and Reflex DC.

ThreeAnglesOneTempo.Title: Three Angles, One Tempo
ThreeAnglesOneTempo.Description: With three or more enemies threatening you, their separate attacks collapse into one rhythm you can read. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves and Perception checks.

FourStepsOneMisstep.Title: Four Steps, One Misstep
FourStepsOneMisstep.Description: With four or more enemies pressing in, one threatening foe loses its footing when you break the shared rhythm. For 1 round, it becomes clumsy 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

TumbleThroughTheTeeth.Title: Tumble Through the Teeth
TumbleThroughTheTeeth.Description: You may immediately attempt to Tumble Through one creature that currently threatens you as a free action, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to the Acrobatics check. That creature cannot use reactions triggered by this movement. Apply this result manually.

CrowdBuildsYourMomentum.Title: The Crowd Builds Your Momentum
CrowdBuildsYourMomentum.Description: Every correction an enemy makes gives you another fraction of motion. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all your Speeds.

TurnTheirEyesSideways.Title: Turn Their Eyes Sideways
TurnTheirEyesSideways.Description: A threatening source loses track of the whole formation when you vanish from its expected line. For 1 round, it takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks and Perception DC.

GapStaysOpen.Title: The Gap Stays Open
GapStaysOpen.Description: Once you find the opening, your body remembers it. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks and Reflex DC.

OneBodyBlocksTheNext.Title: One Body Blocks the Next
OneBodyBlocksTheNext.Description: You make a threatening source occupy exactly the wrong place for the rest of the ring. For 1 round, it is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC.

NeverStopInTheCenter.Title: Never Stop in the Center
NeverStopInTheCenter.Description: The ring can only close around the place you were. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all your Speeds and a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception DC.

TheirEyesCollide.Title: Their Eyes Collide
TheirEyesCollide.Description: A threatening source loses you behind its own allies for a fraction of a second. For 1 round, it is dazzled and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks.

MotionHidesMotion.Title: Motion Hides Motion
MotionHidesMotion.Description: The ring moves too much to keep your exact line clear. For 1 round, you are concealed and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

ThreeThreatsOneSlipstream.Title: Three Threats, One Slipstream
ThreeThreatsOneSlipstream.Description: With three or more enemies closing in, the wake of one movement hides the next. For 1 round, you are concealed and gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds.

FourThreatsOneTangle.Title: Four Threats, One Tangle
FourThreatsOneTangle.Description: With four or more enemies packed into the ring, the hostile source tangles itself in the formation. For 1 round, it is off-guard and clumsy 1.

CutBetweenTheirReactions.Title: Cut Between Their Reactions
CutBetweenTheirReactions.Description: You move in the instant when every enemy expects someone else to stop you. You may immediately Step twice as free actions; enemies that currently threaten you cannot use reactions triggered by either Step. Apply this result manually.

SourceLosesTheLane.Title: The Source Loses the Lane
SourceLosesTheLane.Description: A threatening source finds its route to you clogged by its own side. For 1 round, it takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds and a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC.

YouAreTheMovingGap.Title: You Are the Moving Gap
YouAreTheMovingGap.Description: The space between enemies travels with you instead of closing behind you. For 1 round, you are concealed and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves.

MakeThemTurnTooFar.Title: Make Them Turn Too Far
MakeThemTurnTooFar.Description: A threatening source twists after you and gives up its balance to do it. For 1 round, it is dazzled and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC.

TheRingCannotFaceEverywhere.Title: The Ring Cannot Face Everywhere
TheRingCannotFaceEverywhere.Description: You force the circle to keep turning until its sightlines fray. For 1 round, you are concealed and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception DC.

RunTheSeam.Title: Run the Seam
RunTheSeam.Description: You see the moving seam between overlapping threat zones. You may immediately Stride up to your Speed as a free action; enemies that currently threaten you cannot use reactions triggered by this movement, and if possible you must end where fewer enemies threaten you. Apply this result manually.

CenterOfYourOwnMind.Title: Center of Your Own Mind
CenterOfYourOwnMind.Description: Every threat pushes inward, but your thoughts keep one inviolate center. For 1 round, your Will DC gains a +2 circumstance bonus.

NoiseBecomesRhythm.Title: Noise Becomes Rhythm
NoiseBecomesRhythm.Description: Too many threats compete for your attention and become a pattern instead of a distraction. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.

ThreeThreatsOneAnswer.Title: Three Threats, One Answer
ThreeThreatsOneAnswer.Description: With three or more enemies pressing in, every demand receives the same answer: no. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves and Will DC.

FourThreatsOneDoubt.Title: Four Threats, One Doubt
FourThreatsOneDoubt.Description: Four or more enemies close around you, and the hostile source is the first to wonder why you still stand. It becomes stupefied 1 for 1 round.

FearFindsNoLeader.Title: Fear Finds No Leader
FearFindsNoLeader.Description: The fear meant to make the ring feel larger rebounds toward the voice that shaped it. The hostile source becomes frightened 1 for 1 round.

NoCommandOwnsTheCircle.Title: No Command Owns the Circle
NoCommandOwnsTheCircle.Description: A hostile will tries to turn the crowd into a cage and only sharpens your resistance. After a mental effect, for 1 round you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves and resistance 2 to mental damage.

CrowdCannotEnterWithThem.Title: The Crowd Cannot Enter With Them
CrowdCannotEnterWithThem.Description: The enemies around you can crowd your body, not your thoughts. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to mental damage and a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception DC.

NameAboveTheNoise.Title: Your Name Above the Noise
NameAboveTheNoise.Description: Threats, curses, and shouted orders blur together beneath the certainty of who you are. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to checks based on Wisdom and Charisma.

PresenceFillsTheRing.Title: Presence Fills the Ring
PresenceFillsTheRing.Description: Surrounded, you stop looking like prey and start looking like the reason the circle formed. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks.

AnswerEveryVoice.Title: Answer Every Voice
AnswerEveryVoice.Description: Choose one enemy that currently threatens you. You may immediately attempt to Demoralize that enemy as a free action. Apply this result manually.

MakeOneVoiceFalter.Title: Make One Voice Falter
MakeOneVoiceFalter.Description: You meet one threatening enemy's pressure with a stare that breaks its certainty. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Will DC and Intimidation checks.

HoldTheInnerLine.Title: Hold the Inner Line
HoldTheInnerLine.Description: The circle closes around your body, not your judgment. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves and Perception DC.

ThreeThreatsOneStillness.Title: Three Threats, One Stillness
ThreeThreatsOneStillness.Description: With three or more enemies pressing in, your attention stops scattering and becomes absolute. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will DC and Perception checks.

FourThreatsOneCrackedNerve.Title: Four Threats, One Cracked Nerve
FourThreatsOneCrackedNerve.Description: With four or more enemies packed around you, the threatening source realizes that numbers are no longer enough. For 1 round, it becomes frightened 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Will DC.

PassTheDefianceOn.Title: Pass the Defiance On
PassTheDefianceOn.Description: Your refusal steadies someone else. Choose one ally within 30 feet who can hear you; that ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next Will save before the end of their next turn. Apply this result manually.

TheRingHearsYouBreathe.Title: The Ring Hears You Breathe
TheRingHearsYouBreathe.Description: You make your calm audible, and the circle has to reckon with it. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks and Will DC.

TheirCertaintyBreaksFirst.Title: Their Certainty Breaks First
TheirCertaintyBreaksFirst.Description: A threatening enemy expected the ring to make you hesitate. Instead, it loses the initiative of conviction. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and class DC.

FearHasTooManyFaces.Title: Fear Has Too Many Faces
FearHasTooManyFaces.Description: When fear comes from inside a ring of enemies, you stop giving any one face authority over you. After a fear effect, for 1 round you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Will DC.

AMentalGripLeavesAnOpening.Title: A Mental Grip Leaves an Opening
AMentalGripLeavesAnOpening.Description: A threatening enemy reaches for your thoughts and exposes its own focus. After a mental effect, for 1 round the hostile source is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Will DC.

MindAboveTheRing.Title: Mind Above the Ring
MindAboveTheRing.Description: You stop reacting to the circle and begin reading it as a whole. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to class DC and Perception DC.

OneMindBreaksRank.Title: One Mind Breaks Rank
OneMindBreaksRank.Description: A threatening source realizes that the circle has not made you smaller. For 1 round, it becomes stupefied 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

TheCircleCannotNameYou.Title: The Circle Cannot Name You
TheCircleCannotNameYou.Description: Their certainty stops defining the space you occupy. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves and class DC.

ThreeThreatsOneAudience.Title: Three Threats, One Audience
ThreeThreatsOneAudience.Description: With three or more enemies pressing in, every hostile face becomes an audience for your refusal. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation and Perception checks.

FourThreatsOneCollapseOfNerve.Title: Four Threats, One Collapse of Nerve
FourThreatsOneCollapseOfNerve.Description: With four or more enemies crowding you, the threatening source finally understands that the ring has become a stage for your defiance. For 1 round, it becomes frightened 1 and stupefied 1.

TurnTheChorusOnItself.Title: Turn the Chorus on Itself
TurnTheChorusOnItself.Description: You answer the ring loudly enough that its threats begin competing with one another. You may immediately attempt to Create a Diversion against all enemies that currently threaten you as a free action. Apply this result manually.

ShoutDownTheChorus.Title: Shout Down the Chorus
ShoutDownTheChorus.Description: When a threatening source tries to dominate the ring with sound, your refusal drowns it out. After an auditory effect, for 1 round the hostile source is deafened and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks.

FearTurnsIntoCommand.Title: Fear Turns Into Command
FearTurnsIntoCommand.Description: You take the energy of the fear effect and use it to seize the moment. After a fear effect, for 1 round you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and Will DC.

TheRingHasToListen.Title: The Ring Has to Listen
TheRingHasToListen.Description: Your composure forces attention instead of merely surviving it. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy and Perception checks.

TheirFocusPointsInward.Title: Their Focus Points Inward
TheirFocusPointsInward.Description: A threatening source spends so much attention holding the ring together that it exposes itself. For 1 round, it is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to class DC.

CallTheOpening.Title: Call the Opening
CallTheOpening.Description: Your clarity finds a path not only for you. Choose one ally within 30 feet who can hear you; that ally may immediately Step as a free action toward you or toward a space adjacent to one of the enemies threatening you. Apply this result manually.

FindTheJoint.Title: Find the Joint
FindTheJoint.Description: Power builds armor around the obvious places. Your critical hit finds the seam instead. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC and Fortitude DC.

BeneathTheirReach.Title: Beneath Their Reach
BeneathTheirReach.Description: The stronger foe has reach, weight, and confidence. You have already stepped inside all three. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves.

MakeTheGiantKneel.Title: Make the Giant Kneel
MakeTheGiantKneel.Description: Your critical hit steals the footing from a foe who should have been impossible to move. For 1 round, the target is prone and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC.

ReachBecomesLeverage.Title: Reach Becomes Leverage
ReachBecomesLeverage.Description: The larger foe has farther to recover when you spoil the line of the attack. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks and a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

FiveLevelsOneMistake.Title: Five Levels, One Mistake
FiveLevelsOneMistake.Description: A foe five or more levels above you makes one mistake, and you make it enormous. For 1 round, the target is clumsy 1 and off-guard.

FormulaAboveYourStation.Title: Formula Above Your Station
FormulaAboveYourStation.Description: The spell succeeds where the mathematics said it should not. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to spell attack rolls and spell DC.

MagicFindsTheSmallestCrack.Title: Magic Finds the Smallest Crack
MagicFindsTheSmallestCrack.Description: Your spell turns a hairline flaw in impossible defenses into a breach everyone can exploit. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC, saving throws, and Perception checks.

GreaterPowerRecoils.Title: Greater Power Recoils
GreaterPowerRecoils.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, the critical spell makes its own power recoil through the opening. For 1 round, the target is stupefied 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to class DC.

ImpossibleArcPerfectImpact.Title: Impossible Arc, Perfect Impact
ImpossibleArcPerfectImpact.Description: The scale of the opponent makes the impossible trajectory suddenly obvious. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to spell damage rolls and Perception checks.

ReadTheColossus.Title: Read the Colossus
ReadTheColossus.Description: The critical spell reveals how the stronger foe is put together. You may immediately Recall Knowledge about the target as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus. Apply this result manually.

CutTheLongLever.Title: Cut the Long Lever
CutTheLongLever.Description: Against a larger foe, the limb that grants reach is also a lever. Your critical hit spoils it. For 1 round, the target is enfeebled 1 and takes a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

BeneathTheCenterOfMass.Title: Beneath the Center of Mass
BeneathTheCenterOfMass.Description: A foe two or more size steps above you has power everywhere except the angle directly beneath its balance. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks and Strike damage.

MakePowerCommit.Title: Make Power Commit
MakePowerCommit.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, the only safe opening is the one it creates by committing too much. For 1 round, the target is clumsy 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Fortitude DC.

HitAboveTheNumbers.Title: Hit Above the Numbers
HitAboveTheNumbers.Description: The stronger foe can absorb ordinary pressure. Your critical hit attacks the places its statistics cannot cover. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Fortitude DC and Reflex DC.

RunTheGiantsLine.Title: Run the Giant's Line
RunTheGiantsLine.Description: Your critical hit opens a route through the larger foe's own stance. You may immediately attempt to Tumble Through the target as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Acrobatics check. Apply this result manually.

PowerNeedsRoom.Title: Power Needs Room
PowerNeedsRoom.Description: The critical spell denies the stronger foe the space its power expects. For 1 round, the target takes a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds and a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC.

MakeTheImpossibleBlink.Title: Make the Impossible Blink
MakeTheImpossibleBlink.Description: The stronger foe has seen power before. It has not seen yours land like this. For 1 round, the target is dazzled and takes a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

FiveLevelsOneBreach.Title: Five Levels, One Breach
FiveLevelsOneBreach.Description: Against a foe five or more levels above you, the critical spell proves that even impossible defenses can fail together. For 1 round, the target is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to saving throws.

TheFirstCrackIsReal.Title: The First Crack Is Real
TheFirstCrackIsReal.Description: Once your spell proves the stronger foe can be hurt, everyone sees where the legend ends and the target begins. For 1 round, the target gains weakness 1 to all damage and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC.

ShareTheImpossibleOpening.Title: Share the Impossible Opening
ShareTheImpossibleOpening.Description: The critical spell opens a moment too large to keep for yourself. One ally within 30 feet who can see the target may immediately Step as a free action. Apply this result manually.

BreakTheRecovery.Title: Break the Recovery
BreakTheRecovery.Description: The stronger foe tries to reset after the critical hit. You make the recovery cost another opening. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and Perception DC.

SmallTargetHeavyPrice.Title: Small Target, Heavy Price
SmallTargetHeavyPrice.Description: The larger foe loses strength trying to follow an angle built for someone smaller. For 1 round, the target is enfeebled 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC.

FourLevelsOneBadAngle.Title: Four Levels, One Bad Angle
FourLevelsOneBadAngle.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, one bad angle is enough to make overwhelming technique stumble. For 1 round, the target is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC.

CallTheOpening.Title: Call the Opening
CallTheOpening.Description: Your critical hit proves the stronger foe can be reached. Choose one ally within 30 feet who can see the target. That ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next attack roll against the target before the start of your next turn. Apply this result manually.

UseTheirStrengthAgainstTheGuard.Title: Use Their Strength Against the Guard
UseTheirStrengthAgainstTheGuard.Description: A foe at least two size steps larger commits too much mass to stop your hit. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Strike damage and AC.

SpellThroughTheBlindSide.Title: Spell Through the Blind Side
SpellThroughTheBlindSide.Description: The critical spell blooms where the stronger foe cannot track it cleanly. For 1 round, the target is dazzled and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to spell DC.

MagicBendsTheColossus.Title: Magic Bends the Colossus
MagicBendsTheColossus.Description: The larger foe can absorb force, but the critical spell makes that scale betray precision. For 1 round, the target is clumsy 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to class DC.

FiveLevelsStillVulnerable.Title: Five Levels, Still Vulnerable
FiveLevelsStillVulnerable.Description: Against a foe five or more levels above you, the critical spell proves that greater power still has a mind that can lose the thread. For 1 round, the target is stupefied 1 and off-guard.

BorrowTheirPowersEcho.Title: Borrow Their Power's Echo
BorrowTheirPowersEcho.Description: Your spell catches the stronger foe's pressure and sends the rhythm back through your own magic. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to spell damage rolls and saving throws.

SendTheWarningThroughTheLine.Title: Send the Warning Through the Line
SendTheWarningThroughTheLine.Description: The critical spell shows everyone exactly how the stronger foe answers pressure. Choose one ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you. That ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next saving throw against the target before the start of your next turn. Apply this result manually.

UnmovedByTheImpossible.Title: Unmoved by the Impossible
UnmovedByTheImpossible.Description: The stronger foe expected raw force to decide the matter. Your body refuses the premise. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC and Athletics checks.

TheirForceBetraysThem.Title: Their Force Betrays Them
TheirForceBetraysThem.Description: The hostile source commits enough force to crush you and instead exposes its own structure. For 1 round, it takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and Fortitude DC.

SurviveThenStrike.Title: Survive, Then Strike
SurviveThenStrike.Description: You withstand what should have ended the exchange and turn survival into timing. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves and attack rolls.

WeightTurnsAgainstThem.Title: Weight Turns Against Them
WeightTurnsAgainstThem.Description: The hostile source leans on overwhelming strength and finds its own mass fighting back. For 1 round, it is enfeebled 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks.

FiveLevelsStillStanding.Title: Five Levels, Still Standing
FiveLevelsStillStanding.Description: A foe five or more levels above you unleashes its strength and you are still there when the force passes. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws.

HeartAboveTheMeasure.Title: Heart Above the Measure
HeartAboveTheMeasure.Description: The contest says you are outmatched. Your body supplies a different answer. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves and class DC.

ImpactOpensTheGuard.Title: Impact Opens the Guard
ImpactOpensTheGuard.Description: The hostile source expected you to fold and overcommits when you do not. For 1 round, it is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Fortitude DC.

OverreachHasAPrice.Title: Overreach Has a Price
OverreachHasAPrice.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, surviving its full commitment turns strength into imbalance. For 1 round, the hostile source is enfeebled 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC.

SurvivalBecomesCounterforce.Title: Survival Becomes Counterforce
SurvivalBecomesCounterforce.Description: You do not merely absorb the stronger foe's power; you carry it into the answer. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Strike damage and Fortitude saves.

StepIntoTheirShadow.Title: Step Into Their Shadow
StepIntoTheirShadow.Description: The stronger foe's power passes you and leaves one instant in which distance belongs to you. You may immediately Step as a free action. If possible, the Step must reduce the distance to the hostile source. Apply this result manually.

ForceMeetsAFoundation.Title: Force Meets a Foundation
ForceMeetsAFoundation.Description: The stronger foe brings enough force to move anyone. Your critical success proves that you are not anyone. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves, AC, and Fortitude DC.

AnchorBeneathTheColossus.Title: Anchor Beneath the Colossus
AnchorBeneathTheColossus.Description: A larger foe tries to make scale itself the weapon. You find the point where all that mass has to push against you. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, Athletics checks, and Fortitude saves.

FourLevelsSpentStrength.Title: Four Levels, Spent Strength
FourLevelsSpentStrength.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, surviving its full commitment leaves its strength badly placed. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, Athletics checks, and Fortitude DC.

TheBodyKeepsTheLesson.Title: The Body Keeps the Lesson
TheBodyKeepsTheLesson.Description: Your body survives the impossible once and immediately learns from it. For 1 round, you gain 5 temporary Hit Points and a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.

MoveTheImmovable.Title: Move the Immovable
MoveTheImmovable.Description: The larger foe expected you to be the thing that moved. Instead, you get one impossible instant of leverage. If the hostile source is within your reach and you meet the other normal prerequisites for Shove, you may immediately attempt to Shove it as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Athletics check. You can attempt this Shove regardless of the target's size. Otherwise, you may immediately Step toward the hostile source. Apply this result manually.

MassCannotRecover.Title: Mass Cannot Recover
MassCannotRecover.Description: A larger hostile source commits its whole frame and discovers that mass is slow to recover. For 1 round, it is clumsy 1, takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Fortitude DC, and takes a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

EnduranceReadsTheOpening.Title: Endurance Reads the Opening
EnduranceReadsTheOpening.Description: You remain conscious inside pressure that should have erased every useful thought. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks, attack rolls, and class DC.

FiveLevelsStillBreathing.Title: Five Levels, Still Breathing
FiveLevelsStillBreathing.Description: A foe five or more levels above you spends enough power to end the argument. Your body answers by continuing. For 1 round, you gain fast healing 3 and a +1 status bonus to saving throws.

TheirFramePaysThePrice.Title: Their Frame Pays the Price
TheirFramePaysThePrice.Description: You survive the stronger foe's pressure long enough for its own body to become the weak link. For 1 round, the hostile source is enfeebled 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC.

BreakTheImpossibleHold.Title: Break the Impossible Hold
BreakTheImpossibleHold.Description: The stronger foe fails to make your body obey, and for one instant every hold feels breakable. If you are grabbed, restrained, or immobilized by the hostile source, you may immediately attempt to Escape as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus. Otherwise, you may immediately Step. Apply this result manually.

TakeTheMeasureOfForce.Title: Take the Measure of Force
TakeTheMeasureOfForce.Description: The stronger foe tests your body and accidentally teaches you the exact weight of the next impact. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and Perception DC.

TheBiggerTheyLean.Title: The Bigger They Lean
TheBiggerTheyLean.Description: The larger foe commits its whole frame and discovers that mass takes time to recover. For 1 round, the hostile source is clumsy 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC.

FourLevelsForceRunsOut.Title: Four Levels, Force Runs Out
FourLevelsForceRunsOut.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, surviving the full effort leaves its next motion late. For 1 round, the hostile source is slowed 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks.

PainConvertsToLeverage.Title: Pain Converts to Leverage
PainConvertsToLeverage.Description: You absorb what should have folded you and turn the surviving tension into useful force. You gain 3 temporary Hit Points and a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks for 1 round.

StandBeforeTheColossus.Title: Stand Before the Colossus
StandBeforeTheColossus.Description: The stronger foe expects the impact to decide where you belong. If you are prone, you may immediately Stand as a free action; this movement does not trigger reactions from the hostile source. Otherwise, you may immediately Step. Apply this result manually.

FrameOutlastsImpact.Title: Frame Outlasts Impact
FrameOutlastsImpact.Description: Your body takes the stronger foe's measure and refuses to be defined by it. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC and class DC.

TheirWeightBecomesDelay.Title: Their Weight Becomes Delay
TheirWeightBecomesDelay.Description: The larger foe cannot pull all that weight back into guard at once. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds and a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves.

FiveLevelsStrengthBuckles.Title: Five Levels, Strength Buckles
FiveLevelsStrengthBuckles.Description: Against a foe five or more levels above you, surviving the impossible effort makes the stronger body pay for every ounce of force. For 1 round, the hostile source is enfeebled 1 and slowed 1.

EndureThenCommandSpace.Title: Endure, Then Command Space
EndureThenCommandSpace.Description: The stronger foe tried to dictate the battlefield with force. Your survival gives you the authority to push back. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks and class DC.

BringTheWeightDown.Title: Bring the Weight Down
BringTheWeightDown.Description: The larger foe's own mass gives you the line. If the hostile source is within your reach and you meet the normal prerequisites for Trip other than its size restriction, you may immediately attempt to Trip it as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Athletics check, ignoring Trip's normal size restriction. Otherwise, you may immediately Step toward the hostile source. Apply this result manually.

DuckBeneathTheImpossible.Title: Duck Beneath the Impossible
DuckBeneathTheImpossible.Description: The stronger foe fills the battlefield with danger, but scale also creates space beneath the obvious line. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks.

MomentumExposesTheFlank.Title: Momentum Exposes the Flank
MomentumExposesTheFlank.Description: The hostile source commits enough mass to overwhelm you and has too much of itself in motion to recover cleanly. For 1 round, it is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks.

LetTheGiantOvershoot.Title: Let the Giant Overshoot
LetTheGiantOvershoot.Description: You leave the line at the last possible instant and the stronger foe has to drag its own attack back under control. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

FiveLevelsOneEmptySquare.Title: Five Levels, One Empty Square
FiveLevelsOneEmptySquare.Description: Against a larger foe five or more levels above you, one impossible dodge turns its scale into visual clutter. Until the start of your next turn, you are concealed from the hostile source, and you may immediately Step as a free action. Apply this observer-relative concealment manually.

SizeBecomesABlindSpot.Title: Size Becomes a Blind Spot
SizeBecomesABlindSpot.Description: The stronger foe can dominate space but cannot watch every part of it equally well. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Stealth checks.

FootingCannotFollow.Title: Their Footing Cannot Follow
FootingCannotFollow.Description: You change direction faster than the stronger foe can bring its balance with it. For 1 round, the hostile source is clumsy 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC.

ImpactBecomesDistance.Title: Impact Becomes Distance
ImpactBecomesDistance.Description: The force meant to catch you becomes the rhythm of your escape. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your land Speed and a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex DC.

FourLevelsTooMuchMomentum.Title: Four Levels, Too Much Momentum
FourLevelsTooMuchMomentum.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, the force of the failed catch becomes a collapse in posture. For 1 round, the hostile source is prone and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks.

ReadTheShadowNotTheWeapon.Title: Read the Shadow, Not the Weapon
