ReadTheShadowNotTheWeapon.Description: Against something this powerful, watching the weapon is already too late. You read the whole body instead. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks and Reflex DC.

CrossTheDeadAngle.Title: Cross the Dead Angle
CrossTheDeadAngle.Description: The stronger foe's failed attack creates a brief route through the space it cannot immediately cover. You may immediately Step or Take Cover as a free action. If you Step, movement does not trigger reactions from the hostile source. Apply this result manually.

TurnInsideTheSwing.Title: Turn Inside the Swing
TurnInsideTheSwing.Description: A larger hostile source commits to a line built for something slower. You fold inside the arc before it can close. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, Reflex saves, and Acrobatics checks.

TheirReachBecomesYourRoute.Title: Their Reach Becomes Your Route
TheirReachBecomesYourRoute.Description: Two or more size steps of reach create a corridor once you stop fleeing from the obvious direction. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your land Speed and a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

FourLevelsCannotStopShort.Title: Four Levels, Cannot Stop Short
FourLevelsCannotStopShort.Description: Against a threatening foe four or more levels above you, the failed catch becomes an overcommitment it cannot erase. For 1 round, the hostile source is off-guard, takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC, and takes a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

ReadTheImpactBeforeItLands.Title: Read the Impact Before It Lands
ReadTheImpactBeforeItLands.Description: You stop reacting to the strike and start reading the pressure that comes before it. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves, Perception checks, and AC.

SlipBetweenTheirSteps.Title: Slip Between Their Steps
SlipBetweenTheirSteps.Description: A foe at least two size steps larger leaves a moving gap where its reach and footing do not agree. You may immediately move up to 10 feet as a free action. This movement does not trigger reactions from the hostile source and must end no farther from it than you began. Apply this result manually.

TooMuchBodyToTurn.Title: Too Much Body to Turn
TooMuchBodyToTurn.Description: The larger hostile source tries to correct after you pass its line, but there is simply too much of it to turn at once. For 1 round, it is clumsy 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC.

MomentumBecomesYourTempo.Title: Momentum Becomes Your Tempo
MomentumBecomesYourTempo.Description: You survive the stronger foe's speed and steal its rhythm for yourself. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your land Speed and a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and Reflex saves.

FiveLevelsStillAheadOfIt.Title: Five Levels, Still Ahead of It
FiveLevelsStillAheadOfIt.Description: A foe five or more levels above you commits enough speed to make escape look impossible. You are already beyond the answer. For 1 round, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to all Speeds and a +1 status bonus to AC and Reflex saves.

DragTheColossusOffLine.Title: Drag the Colossus Off Line
DragTheColossusOffLine.Description: A larger hostile source follows your escape one fraction too far and has to rebuild its entire line of attack. For 1 round, it takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, Reflex DC, and Perception DC.

OutsideTheKillingLine.Title: Outside the Killing Line
OutsideTheKillingLine.Description: The stronger foe's failed attack gives you more than an empty square; it gives you a route out of the next one. You may immediately Stride up to half your Speed as a free action. This movement must end farther from the hostile source and does not trigger reactions from it. Apply this result manually.

MoveBeforeTheWeightSettles.Title: Move Before the Weight Settles
MoveBeforeTheWeightSettles.Description: The critical dodge leaves you moving while the stronger foe is still committed. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves and Stealth checks.

TooLargeToWatchBothSides.Title: Too Large to Watch Both Sides
TooLargeToWatchBothSides.Description: The larger foe loses your angle across its own scale. For 1 round, the hostile source is dazzled and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Athletics checks.

FourLevelsMomentumBreaksTheTurn.Title: Four Levels, Momentum Breaks the Turn
FourLevelsMomentumBreaksTheTurn.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, the perfect evasion forces overwhelming momentum to finish the wrong movement. For 1 round, the hostile source is slowed 1 and off-guard.

TheGapTravelsWithYou.Title: The Gap Travels with You
TheGapTravelsWithYou.Description: Against a foe at least two size steps larger, every change of angle creates another blind corridor. For 1 round, you gain a 5-foot status bonus to all Speeds and a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks.

VaultTheReach.Title: Vault the Reach
VaultTheReach.Description: The larger foe's reach becomes a line to cross rather than a wall to fear. You may immediately Leap as a free action. This Leap does not trigger reactions from the hostile source. Apply this result manually.

TheyCannotCorrectTwice.Title: They Cannot Correct Twice
TheyCannotCorrectTwice.Description: The stronger foe adjusts once and has nothing left for your second angle. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Acrobatics checks and a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

TurnEvasionIntoPressure.Title: Turn Evasion into Pressure
TurnEvasionIntoPressure.Description: The critical escape is not retreat. It is the instant you choose the next attack line. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and AC.

FiveLevelsRunTheImpossibleLine.Title: Five Levels, Run the Impossible Line
FiveLevelsRunTheImpossibleLine.Description: Against a foe five or more levels above you, perfect timing opens a route that should not exist. You may immediately Stride up to your Speed as a free action, ending farther from the hostile source than you began. This movement does not trigger reactions from that source. Apply this result manually.

TheColossusLosesTheHorizon.Title: The Colossus Loses the Horizon
TheColossusLosesTheHorizon.Description: The larger foe turns too much body through too little space and loses the battlefield around you. For 1 round, the hostile source is clumsy 1, takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC, and a 5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

NeverWhereTheyMeasured.Title: Never Where They Measured
NeverWhereTheyMeasured.Description: The stronger foe now knows where you were. That is already outdated information. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks, Stealth checks, and Reflex DC.

TheImpossibleHasAName.Title: The Impossible Has a Name
TheImpossibleHasAName.Description: A foe this powerful stops being an abstraction the moment you understand that it can still be opposed. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves and Intimidation checks.

ArroganceCracks.Title: Arrogance Cracks
ArroganceCracks.Description: The stronger foe expected obedience, terror, or hesitation. Your refusal leaves a visible fracture in that certainty. For 1 round, the hostile source is frightened 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception DC.

DefianceBecomesAuthority.Title: Defiance Becomes Authority
DefianceBecomesAuthority.Description: Resisting something far beyond you gives your own intent unexpected weight. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will DC and class DC.

DominanceLosesItsGrip.Title: Dominance Loses Its Grip
DominanceLosesItsGrip.Description: The hostile source presses its mind against yours and discovers that superiority is not the same thing as control. For 1 round, it is stupefied 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Intimidation checks.

FiveLevelsStillNoGod.Title: Five Levels, Still No God
FiveLevelsStillNoGod.Description: Against a foe five or more levels above you, the difference in power becomes undeniable and somehow less frightening for being named. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves, AC, and Perception DC.

SpeakAcrossTheGap.Title: Speak Across the Gap
SpeakAcrossTheGap.Description: You answer overwhelming presence with a voice that refuses to become smaller. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks and Will DC.

TheirCertaintyMissesABeat.Title: Their Certainty Misses a Beat
TheirCertaintyMissesABeat.Description: The stronger foe realizes that its pressure did not move you, and that realization costs it a moment of perfect command. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, Will DC, and Perception DC.

FourLevelsOneDoubt.Title: Four Levels, One Doubt
FourLevelsOneDoubt.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, your refusal plants a doubt powerful enough to survive inside its certainty. For 1 round, the hostile source is frightened 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to class DC.

LookBackWithoutFlinching.Title: Look Back Without Flinching
LookBackWithoutFlinching.Description: You stop measuring yourself against the stronger foe and start measuring the battlefield instead. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks, Intimidation checks, and Will DC.

AnswerTheGiant.Title: Answer the Giant
AnswerTheGiant.Description: The stronger foe tried to impose its will and gave you the perfect moment to answer. You may immediately attempt to Demoralize the hostile source as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus. Apply this result manually; normal Demoralize restrictions still apply.

StandTallerThanTheCommand.Title: Stand Taller Than the Command
StandTallerThanTheCommand.Description: The stronger foe's will hits like a decree. You answer by becoming harder to move in mind and sharper in judgment. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves and Perception checks.

TheVoiceFalters.Title: The Voice Falters
TheVoiceFalters.Description: A mental assault from the stronger foe meets resistance sharp enough to break its rhythm. For 1 round, the hostile source is stupefied 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to spell DC.

FourLevelsAuthorityFractures.Title: Four Levels, Authority Fractures
FourLevelsAuthorityFractures.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, a perfect refusal turns certainty into visible strain. For 1 round, the hostile source is frightened 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Will DC and Perception DC.

MeasureTheThreatNotYourself.Title: Measure the Threat, Not Yourself
MeasureTheThreatNotYourself.Description: Once you stop comparing power and start reading intent, the stronger foe becomes a problem instead of a verdict. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks and class DC.

ShareTheDefiance.Title: Share the Defiance
ShareTheDefiance.Description: Your refusal is loud enough to become shelter for someone else. Choose one ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you. That ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the next Will save they attempt before the start of your next turn. Apply this result manually.

MakeTheThreatSoundSmall.Title: Make the Threat Sound Small
MakeTheThreatSoundSmall.Description: The stronger foe's presence loses weight the instant you refuse to grant it authority. For 1 round, the hostile source takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Intimidation, Deception, and Diplomacy checks.

YourMindSetsTheTerms.Title: Your Mind Sets the Terms
YourMindSetsTheTerms.Description: You resist overwhelming will so completely that your own magic and authority snap into focus. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will DC and spell DC.

FiveLevelsNoKneeling.Title: Five Levels, No Kneeling
FiveLevelsNoKneeling.Description: Against a foe five or more levels above you, surviving the pressure becomes proof that the difference in power is not permission to rule you. You gain 5 temporary Hit Points and a +1 status bonus to Will saves for 1 round.

PressureRebounds.Title: Pressure Rebounds
PressureRebounds.Description: The stronger foe drives its mind against yours and finds nowhere for the force to go except back. For 1 round, the hostile source is frightened 1 and stupefied 1, and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Will DC.

AnswerWithACuttingWord.Title: Answer with a Cutting Word
AnswerWithACuttingWord.Description: The stronger foe tried to make you feel small. You find the sentence that makes the imbalance sound ridiculous. If you can use Bon Mot, you may immediately attempt Bon Mot against the hostile source as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Diplomacy check. Apply this result manually; normal Bon Mot restrictions still apply.

YourVoiceCarriesUpward.Title: Your Voice Carries Upward
YourVoiceCarriesUpward.Description: The stronger foe cannot make authority flow only one way. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks, Intimidation checks, and Perception checks.

TheMindOverreaches.Title: The Mind Overreaches
TheMindOverreaches.Description: A mental assault from the stronger foe reaches too far and loses precision on the return. For 1 round, the hostile source is stupefied 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC.

FourLevelsTheCommandCracks.Title: Four Levels, the Command Cracks
FourLevelsTheCommandCracks.Description: Against a foe four or more levels above you, your perfect refusal turns command into hesitation. For 1 round, the hostile source is frightened 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to spell DC.

DefianceHasWeight.Title: Defiance Has Weight
DefianceHasWeight.Description: The stronger foe fails to move your mind and leaves something solid behind. You gain 3 temporary Hit Points and a +1 circumstance bonus to class DC for 1 round.

ReadTheClaimBehindTheThreat.Title: Read the Claim Behind the Threat
ReadTheClaimBehindTheThreat.Description: Resisting the stronger foe strips the performance away from the intent beneath it. You may immediately use Sense Motive against the hostile source as a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Perception check. The normal restriction on repeated attempts still applies. Apply this result manually.

BreakTheResonance.Title: Break the Resonance
BreakTheResonance.Description: You refuse an overwhelming voice so completely that its authority breaks into noise. For 1 round, the hostile source is deafened and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to spell DC.

TurnConvictionIntoCasting.Title: Turn Conviction into Casting
TurnConvictionIntoCasting.Description: Your refusal becomes focus rather than merely survival. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to spell attack rolls and Will DC.

FiveLevelsStillYourName.Title: Five Levels, Still Your Name
FiveLevelsStillYourName.Description: Against a foe five or more levels above you, the pressure fails to decide who you are. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves, class DC, and spell DC.

CertaintyCollapsesInward.Title: Certainty Collapses Inward
CertaintyCollapsesInward.Description: The stronger foe pushes certainty into your mind and feels its own control fracture when you refuse it. For 1 round, the hostile source is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and class DC.

NameTheOpeningForAnother.Title: Name the Opening for Another
NameTheOpeningForAnother.Description: You have heard the stronger foe's certainty crack and can tell someone else exactly where to press. Choose one ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you. That ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next check to Demoralize, Feint, Bon Mot, or Recall Knowledge against the hostile source before the start of your next turn. Apply this result manually.

CutOpenTheExit.Title: Cut Open the Exit
CutOpenTheExit.Description: The critical hit does more than wound. It tears a route through the danger. For 1 round, the target is off-guard and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks.

OneSecondBought.Title: One Second Bought
OneSecondBought.Description: The opening is tiny, but it is yours. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Fortitude saves.

RunOnTheOpening.Title: Run on the Opening
RunOnTheOpening.Description: You do not admire the hit. You use it. For 1 round, you gain a 5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds and a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks.

MakePursuitExpensive.Title: Make Pursuit Expensive
MakePursuitExpensive.Description: The critical hit punishes the instant they try to recover and chase. For 1 round, the target takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds and a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks.

ShieldTheHeartbeat.Title: Shield the Heartbeat
ShieldTheHeartbeat.Description: The hit buys exactly enough time to protect the life behind it. If you are wielding a shield and can Raise a Shield, you may immediately Raise it as a free action. Otherwise, you may immediately Step. Apply this result manually.

CastThroughTheGap.Title: Cast Through the Gap
CastThroughTheGap.Description: The critical spell leaves momentum behind instead of smoke. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to spell attack rolls and a 5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds.

FlashOfAnExit.Title: Flash of an Exit
FlashOfAnExit.Description: The spell lights the one route that was invisible a heartbeat ago. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, Reflex saves, and Perception checks.

DangerBreaksItsStride.Title: Danger Breaks Its Stride
DangerBreaksItsStride.Description: When the danger is already severe, the critical spell turns pursuit into recovery. At danger score 4 or higher, for 1 round the target is clumsy 1 and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks.

StillHereStillMoving.Title: Still Here, Still Moving
StillHereStillMoving.Description: At danger score 5 or higher, the spell proves there is still a future to move toward. For 1 round, you gain 4 temporary Hit Points and a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves.

CollapseTheLineBehindYou.Title: Collapse the Line Behind You
CollapseTheLineBehindYou.Description: The critical spell leaves the pursuer choosing between you and its footing. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex DC and Perception checks.

HoldTogetherLongEnough.Title: Hold Together Long Enough
HoldTogetherLongEnough.Description: The danger fails to break you before the opening appears. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and a 5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds.

ShockFindsNoGrip.Title: Shock Finds No Grip
ShockFindsNoGrip.Description: Your body locks into the one posture that keeps the danger from taking hold. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC and Reflex saves.

PainMarksTheExit.Title: Pain Marks the Exit
PainMarksTheExit.Description: The pain does not blur the world. It outlines the route that is still open. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception and Acrobatics checks.

OneBreathAhead.Title: One Breath Ahead
OneBreathAhead.Description: You steal one clean breath from the edge of collapse. For 1 round, you gain fast healing 2 and a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves.

UpBeforeItCloses.Title: Up Before It Closes
UpBeforeItCloses.Description: Your body answers before the danger can finish closing around you. If you are prone, you may immediately Stand as a free action. Otherwise, you may immediately Step. Apply this result manually.

ToxinLosesTheRace.Title: The Toxin Loses the Race
ToxinLosesTheRace.Description: The poison is dangerous, but it is not faster than your refusal to fall. Against an incoming poison effect, for 1 round you gain resistance 2 to poison damage and a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves.

BodyRefusesToLock.Title: The Body Refuses to Lock
BodyRefusesToLock.Description: Muscle, breath, and heartbeat all choose the same answer: not yet. For 1 round, you gain 3 temporary Hit Points and a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC.

FourPointsStillBreathing.Title: Four Points, Still Breathing
FourPointsStillBreathing.Description: At danger score 4 or higher, survival becomes its own burst of momentum. For 1 round, you gain 3 temporary Hit Points, a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves, and a 5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds.

FivePointsOneMoreSecond.Title: Five Points, One More Second
FivePointsOneMoreSecond.Description: At danger score 5 or higher, your body manufactures one impossible second more. For 1 round, you gain fast healing 3, a +1 status bonus to saving throws, and a 5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds.

TheExitStaysOpen.Title: The Exit Stays Open
TheExitStaysOpen.Description: The danger had one chance to stop your body. It missed. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Fortitude DC and a 5-foot circumstance bonus to all Speeds.
